A mix of reproducible genomics pipelines and interactive reanalysis portals.
Portals are password-gated deployments built for specific labs — reach out for
access.

## Genomics pipelines

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card}
### De novo mutation rate in Pacific oyster
*Crassostrea gigas* trio sequencing to detect and quantify germline de novo
mutations. A 22-step workflow: BWA alignment, GATK4 `HaplotypeCaller`, joint
genotyping, quality filtering, trio-based DNM identification, `SnpEff`
annotation, and exclusion of repetitive regions (`RepeatMasker`). Retains
GATK3 indel realignment alongside GATK4 calling.

`GATK3/4` · `BWA` · `SAMtools` · `Picard` · `VCFtools` · `PLINK` · `ADMIXTURE` · `SnpEff`

[Code →](https://github.com/rachelzh-hua/oyster_mutation)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Mussel larvae genomics
Population-genomics analysis of mussel larvae in R.

`R`

[Code →](https://github.com/rachelzh-hua/mussel_larvae)
:::
